persona: Bank operations officer who has informally gathered requirements
resumeText:
Rahul Menon | Kochi | rahul.menon@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Operations Officer, Malabar Co-operative Bank, Kochi (2022 - present)
- Collected requirements from branch staff for a new loan-tracking screen and wrote them up as a requirements document for the IT vendor.
- Coordinated between branch managers and the IT vendor to agree scope and go-live dates.
- Led user acceptance testing with 12 branch users before the loan-tracking release.
- Wrote weekly status mails to the regional head on project progress.

Operations Officer, Malabar Co-operative Bank (2020 - 2022)
- Processed account opening and KYC checks for retail customers.

EDUCATION
MBA (Finance), Cochin University of Science and Technology, 2020

SKILLS
MS Excel, MS Word, core banking (Finacle), requirement documentation
